target_customer: Property owners and operators (real estate investors, landlords), utilities and charge point operators with apartment and underground garage parking
problem: EV charging in apartment buildings and underground garages needs expensive wiring and a reliable internet connection. HeyCharge chargers authenticate and bill over Bluetooth without an internet connection.
business_model: Hardware sales plus software, CPO services and SDK licensing to property operators and partners
product_category: Offline EV charging hardware and software

founders.name: Chris Carde
prior_employers: UC Davis Hybrid Electric Vehicle Center
founders.background_notes: Per YC page. Company article says he tried to charge in his apartment garage in 2017.

founders.name: Robert Lasowski
founders.background_notes: YC page: career since 2005 in connected, shared and electric mobility; employers not named.

technical_complexity.rationale: Custom charger hardware, Bluetooth authentication and billing, and compliance with charging standards are demanding for a small team, plus patent-pending security.

defensibility.rationale: Patent pending offline approach and installed chargers at landlords create some lock in, but charger makers could add Bluetooth billing.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source found showing incumbents copying the offline approach; BMW's venture arm invested instead.

market_need_then: TechCrunch's seed coverage says roughly 80 percent of EV charging happens in underground car parks that often lack connectivity, and the founder cites his own 2017 apartment garage problem.

identity.voice_and_tone: Upbeat and grateful in the founding announcement

brand_strength.rationale: Friendly descriptive compound name with real estate customers; no brand press found beyond product and funding news.

outcome_analysis: HeyCharge raised a 4.7 million dollar seed led by BMW i Ventures in January 2022, signed property partners such as Vonovia (2025) and MEAG (2024), and won a 2.5 million euro EIC grant in February 2026. Its offline Bluetooth approach targets a real gap in underground garages and EV adoption in Europe helps. No Series A was found, and the company remains small.
notes: Competitors list is empty: dated searches returned no pre-2022 sources naming rivals and the founding announcement names none. The 2026 grant is EUR 2.5M; amount_usd left null because no USD figure was stated by a source (CB Insights lists 2.7M). A Seedtable listing labels the grant as seed, treated as a mislabel.
